summary: Join our Public Financial Management and Oversight Training to master essential skills for effective governance and financial accountability in public sectors.
lede: Public financial management helps professionals plan, track, and scrutinize how public resources are budgeted and spent. Designed for public finance officers, auditors, and program managers, this training covers the PFM cycle, analysis of budgets and financial reports, and ways to identify control gaps and spending risks. Participants also explore audit oversight and how to connect expenditure with performance and value for money.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly interact with public budgets, expenditures, reports, and oversight processes.
audience: Public sector finance and budget officers
Accountants and financial controllers in government entities
Internal auditors and risk management officers
Members and staff of Parliament or legislative
Supreme Audit Institution staff and external auditors
Program and project managers in ministries, departments
modules: Legal, Policy, and Institutional Frameworks for PFM
Budget Execution, Cash Management, and Procurement
Financial Reporting and Public Sector Accounting
Internal Control, Internal Audit, and Risk Management
External Audit, Parliamentary Oversight, and Public Accounts
Fraud, Corruption Risks, and Red Flags in Public Finance
Performance, Value for Money, and Public Expenditure Reviews
Communicating Financial Insights and Oversight Findings
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial principles and prior experience with public sector budgeting or financial management.
